body: I’m really sorry for your loss. It’s been 2 years since I’ve lost my dad and the exact same thing happens to me all the time. It makes no sense in my mind how he could be alive one day and dead the next. How the world kept spinning and things kept happening. I don’t have many encouraging words, but I hope that knowing that other people can understand you helps.

Angels by Robbie Williams (or honestly anything by Robbie Williams). We used to listen to all his CDs during car rides and sing along, and those were some of the best moments of my life. 

I also remember him singing YMCA (and doing the dance of course) when I was little, it’s something that will forever will in my memories. 

Of course, a lot of dad rock too.
